ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent proposal to overhaul the Minnesota Medicaid system and potential connections to alleged fraud schemes.
questions: What are the potential connections between the proposed overhaul and alleged fraud schemes?
How much money is at stake in the Medicaid system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and waste in the Medicaid system. I will use data analysis and public records to investigate the connections between the proposed overhaul and alleged fraud schemes.
